description:
Plan a publish. Returns a signed plan and a preview — it does NOT write anything.

Use for:
- publishing a generated page as a CRM blog post
- adding products, prices and collections to a client's store

Hand the returned planId to site_run once a human has approved it. The plan is
signed, so site_run can only execute the exact legs that were shown: the
capabilities, the target location and the parameters are all covered. Approving
a plan approves THAT plan, not a plan.

Note on what is possible: funnels and funnel pages are read-only across the whole
API — there is no create-page endpoint for anyone. Blog posts and store objects
are the writable surfaces, which is why those are what this plans.

actions.description: What to do. Each becomes one leg of the plan.

locationId.description: The client sub-account to write to.

name: site_plan
